content: Jien kunla qienli bareisan noyenlai shunji. Qienlishi man Hudase irezho. Soyuji qienli bareichenlashi Huda jinjisan wo.
Ingiese qienli bareichenlai fandui giese Huda jinjisanyi fandui giezho. Fandui giesanla goyadene faikui ereizho.
Noyenlashi gouni giesanlai ayighachen pusho, doghunni giesanlai ayighachen wo. Chi qienli bareichenlase ulie ayine giezhou? Gouni giema, hhela chii kuaine.
Hhelashi tai haochude olusan Hudai hoji wo. Chi doghunni giese indan ayikui wo. Hhela khudoghoi belien bareisan pusho. Hhelashi doghunni giesan kunlai faichen Hudai hoji wo.
Ingiese ta bixi shunji, zinie Hudai hokuruku yenyinghala pusho, lianxinni yenyinghala wo.
Ta shui ogikuyeshi ene yenyin wo. Hhelashi zhomen ene shiqinyi gonjisan Hudai hoji wo.
Jien kunlade indan ogikui ogi. Shui ghurasande shui ogi, baer ghurasande baer ogi. Indan zunjichenlai zunji, danren giekulai danren gie.
Nieniedene orekuse chugo kiemade zhan bu chai. Kunlade orechenla guijinni chenjighawo.
Piofen bu gie, kun bu ala, bu ghula, tanxin bu gie giesan minlin, psedu guijinla man goyadene mutun giebeidene ore giesan ene minlinde bouizho.
Orechen kun giebeidene doghunni ulie giene. Ingiese oreku guijinni chenjighawo.
Ingiekushi edeshi yan shihou bikui ta mejiene. Ta hhunturazhi xiereiku shihou wo. Matanyi jiuiku matan dei xianxin gieku shihouse ede chadashizho.
Xieni daozhi ogheine giezho. Ingiese matan kharanide giesan shiqinlai jiedene gieghantu baohu gieku majiani musiye.
Matan udude gieku mutun yan gieliuzhe donzhende gieye. Lon naduzhi sudoku, lon kijiezhi hu gieku, jianjinduzhi dubilieku enelai bu gieye.
Khareidene Ezhan Ersa Mexihai musi. Zui gieku durande jihui bu ogizhi nefuxinni bu dagha.
